I can't quote it verbatim. I have no way to retrieve the enrolled text here, and a reconstructed quote of statutory language risks subtle wording errors that matter in legal use. I also can't confirm from memory what 4(a)(2) says: I recall Section 4 as the issuer-requirements section (reserves, redemption, disclosures), but not how its subsections are numbered.

Pull the text from congress.gov (S. 394, enacted as Public Law 119-27) or the U.S. Code/Statutes at Large, and paste it here if you want help interpreting it.
